bestBets.overview: Multiple on-pacers will ensure a quicker than usual tempo here. JOHNNY BE GOOD found city class too strong behind an impressive unbeaten filly first-up but will be better suited back at this level at the provincials. JUSTIBELLA got the money on the synthetic last time out but has sound wet track form on the turf. BREAK THE TABOO is on the fresh side for this but ran on well at this level at Swan Hill at her last run. ARIZONA LUCK is another that has been freshened but wasn't disgraced in harder contests in recent runs.

raceTips.comment: The in-form Tom Dabernig pair look the top two winning chances, in what is a very even contest. Dubai Dancer was excellent 2 starts ago behind subsequent Caulfield winner Puglia. Jade Smith rides her well and keeps her flowing. From the wide draw she can cross, lead and be hard to catch. Stablemate Terraflight was very brave in defeat last start in driving rain at this track/trip. She is racing very well in this grade, but a slightly firmer track may be against her.  Break The Taboo was too far back on a slow tempo last start. She comes here almost 5 weeks between runs but can put herself in a winning position from the inside draw. Arizona Luck’s best is good enough, but her past 2 runs have been below par for her. Justibella broke her MDN last start on the Ballarat Synth and has performed well on heavy ground earlier this campaign. Both Budjik Boy and Johnny Be Good have been freshened, any market support will be telling

HOODYS HORSE  led for a long way when not disgraced at Geelong first-up and will be much fitter for that outing. raceTips.comment: Sephia has been heavily backed in early betting. She is ready to win 4th up and there has been a lot of merit to each of her runs, closing strongly from the rear. Although she’s drawn wide again, Lachy Neindorf jumps aboard and he can have her building into the race at the right time. Kingsford was an excellent run first up on H10 ground here 2 weeks ago. He made a wide sustained run around the bend and closed strongly. The rise in distance looks ideal and he is still on the up. Hoodys Horse is on the quick 6 day back-up, goes forward and can be strong in the finish. This is probably weaker overall than the race he contested last Friday at Geelong.
